Step 3: Review the options: (A) Chicago, (B) Orlando, (C) New York City, (D) Portland.
Step 4: Confirm that "ORD" corresponds to Chicago, whereas Orlando uses MCO, New York City uses JFK/LGA/EWR, and Portland uses PDX/PWM.
Step 5: Match the correct city to option (A).
